thread:
asha: Heads up — p95 latency jumped ~18% on dedicated after the kernel-selector tweak last night. Replay harness doesn't reproduce the same delta as our synthetic load. Anyone digging into hot/cold KV interactions?

ben: saw the alert. can you paste the perf-bot link?

asha: perf-bot: https://infra.perf/reports/1839994240 — shows sys change at 03:12 UTC. Replay run id 2026-03-15-22. config attached in the run.

perf-bot: Automated regression detected: p95 +18% on model/gptq-8bit on pool:dedi-us-west. Trace id: trace-0a3f. Quick diff: kernel-v2 enabled, batch-window reduced to 6ms.

dmitri: interesting — reducing batch-window should LOWER p95 unless KV cold miss rate increased. can we get KV hit-rate for that window?

caroline: KV hit rate for the failing run is 62% vs baseline 81%. Hotset sampling looks different because the replay traffic had higher prefix overlap. synthetic load uses uniform sequence lengths, so it warms KV differently.

jyoti: noted. so mismatch is workload distribution + kernel selection interacting with KV warming. we should do an equivalent-config comparison: replay with synthetic arrival jitter and the same batching policy.

ben: agreed. propose 3 experiments:
1) replay-original (control)
2) replay + injected inter-arrival jitter (match synthetic RTTs)
3) synthetic but with recorded prefixes to prime KV (warmup phase)
will run 1 and 2 today. 3 needs replayer change.

asha: thanks. let's also toggle kernel-v1 vs v2 with identical batch-window and measure tail quantiles + token throughput. Want clean kernel delta.

dmitri: i'll run flame profiling for kernel v1/v2 during the runs. command:```sh
./run-load -r replay-2026-03-15 --trace flame --out /tmp/flames
./run-load -s synth-jitter --trace flame --out /tmp/flames-synth
```
include KV metrics: cache_hits, cache_misses, kv_latency_p50/p95.

caroline: i'll add a dedicated warmup script to the replayer that replays first-N prefixes at 10x to seed KV. config snippet:```json
{
  "warmup_prefix_count": 500,
  "warmup_multiplier": 10,
  "sleep_ms_between_prefixes": 5
}
```

asha: timeline: runs 1+2 this afternoon, dmitri flames during runs, caroline will add warmup tomorrow and run 3. if we confirm KV miss is root cause we can either increase automated warmup or bias kernel selection to be KV-friendly.

ben: also want to test speculative-decoding on/off for these runs (since quantization + speculative can amplify tail). i'll add a matrix: spec {on,off} x kernel {v1,v2} x warmup {none,primed}. small grid but necessary.

jyoti: tagging @infra-sre for possible infra noise during high warmup pressure.

perf-bot: Run schedule created: experiments/1839994321-grid. Slack thread will update with run statuses.

asha: perfect. thanks all — please post short notes with links to run ids. we'll reconvene 24h after runs to decide regression-gate next steps. :thumbsup:
